instances.spoken_text: Linked-list node values are nineteen, twenty-four, six, thirteen, twenty-eight, ten, zero, one. Reverse every complete group of three nodes, leaving a shorter final group unchanged. What values should your function return, as a list?

follow_up.question: Why save the node after a triple before reversing links?
follow_up.reference: It is the connection to the untouched suffix. Saving it prevents the reversal from losing the remainder of the list.
